samples.xml_description:
<module id="barrel_shifter">
	<!-- Description of the module -->
    <description>A 8-bit barrel shifter implementing efficient bit shifting or rotation based on control inputs.</description>
	
    <!-- Definition of input/output ports -->
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input data to be shifted or rotated.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">Control signal specifying the number of positions to rotate/shift.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit output after shifting or rotating.</output>
    </ports>
	
    <!-- Parameter descriptions can be added here if needed -->
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
	
    <!-- Logic description section -->
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Internal signal declarations
        reg [7:0] mux_stage1;
        reg [7:0] mux_stage2;
        reg [7:0] mux_stage3;
		
        // Combinational logic for barrel shifter functionality
        always @(*) begin
            case ({ctrl[2], ctrl[1]})
                2'b00: begin
                    mux_stage1 = in;
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    mux_stage1 = {in[6:0], in[7]};
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    mux_stage1 = {in[5:0], in[7:6]};
                end
                default: begin
                    mux_stage1 = {in[4:0], in[7:5]};
                end
            endcase
			
            case (ctrl[0])
                1'b0: begin
                    mux_stage2 = mux_stage1;
                end
                default: begin
                    mux_stage2 = {mux_stage1[6:0], mux_stage1[7]};
                end
            endcase
			
            case (ctrl[2])
                1'b0: begin
                    mux_stage3 = mux_stage2;
                end
                default: begin
                    mux_stage3 = {mux_stage2[5:0], mux_stage2[7:6]};
                end
            endcase
        end
		
        // Assigning the final output
        assign out = mux_stage3;
    </logic_description>
	
    <!-- Detailed implementation description goes here -->
    <implementation>Barrel shifter functionality implemented using 2-to-1 multiplexers for shifting/rotating operations.</implementation>
</module>
